newsitem.title: CHINA: Tremor rocks west China, no casualties reported.
newsitem.headline: Tremor rocks west China, no casualties reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.3 on the Richter scale rocked a remote and sparsely populated area in China's far-northwestern Xinjiang region on Saturday, the Xinhua news agency said.
The tremor struck at 1.54 a.m. (1754 GMT Friday), but there were no reports of any casualties or damage, the agency said.
The effects of the earthquake had been felt in the area around Pishan county on the edge of the huge Taklimakan desert which covers much of Xinjiang region, it said.

Experts say the last few years of this century will be a period of intense seismological activity in China, and authorities have vowed to step up action to improve emergency services and boost construction standards.
